about: 재고조정조회 [인쇄] · [이력조회] (원본 E040614 2026-10-13 실측) — 간편재고조정 1건을 API 로 만들고, 안 고르고 [인쇄] 는 '리스트에 선택된 자료가 없습니다.', 고르면 재고조정전표 창. [이력조회] 창에 '신규' 줄, 지우면 '삭제' 줄이 붙는다. 만든 조정은 지운다(재고는 되돌아간다).

shots.name: 인쇄 · 이력조회
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const st=(await window.__api('GET','/stock')).body.find((s)=>Number(s.quantity)>=1);const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const r=await window.__api('POST','/stock-adjustments',{type:'ADJUST',itemId:st.itemId,warehouseId:st.warehouseId,actualQty:Number(st.quantity)+2,adjustDate:ymd,reason:'QA재고1 이력'});sessionStorage.setItem('adjH',JSON.stringify({id:r.body.id,no:r.body.adjustNo,date:ymd}));return r.status})()

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const S=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('adjH'));const r=await window.__api('DELETE','/stock-adjustments/'+S.id);const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const h=(await window.__api('GET','/stock-adjustments/histories?sort=%EA%B0%84%ED%8E%B8&from='+ymd+'&to='+ymd)).body;sessionStorage.setItem('adjHdel',String(r.status)+':'+h.filter((x)=>x.adjustNo===S.no).map((x)=>x.action).join(','));return true})()
